title: Claude Code 06: Claude ko check do, done sach me done #shorts
description:
Claude Code 06: Best practices. Claude Code ne kaha done, par kaam adhura? Official best practices page ka hal: Claude ko ek aisa check do jo pass ya fail bataye (test, build, linter). Teen tareeke: prompt me likho (tests pass hone tak chalao), /goal se condition set karo, ya Stop hook lagao jo check pass hone tak rukne nahi dega. Sirf done sunkar mat mano, evidence mango: kaun sa command chala aur uska output. Jo rule kabhi nahi tootna chahiye, use CLAUDE.md me nahi, hook me daalo.

Source (official):
https://code.claude.com/docs/en/best-practices

Unofficial channel, not affiliated with Anthropic.

Note: the docs crops are our own capture of the official page (key lines highlighted). The terminal windows are illustrations using example commands. Synthetic voice.
